From 5651e5e094591f479adad5830ac1bc45196a39b3 Mon Sep 17 00:00:00 2001
From: Eric Anholt <eric@anholt.net>
Date: Fri, 9 Mar 2018 15:33:32 -0800
Subject: [PATCH] drm/panel: simple: Fix the bus format for the Ontat panel

This fixes bad color output.  When I was first testing the device I
had the DPI hardware set to 666 mode, but apparently in the refactor
to use the bus_format information from the panel driver, I failed to
actually update the panel.

Signed-off-by: Eric Anholt <eric@anholt.net>
Fixes: e8b6f561b2ee ("drm/panel: simple: Add the 7" DPI panel from Adafruit")
Cc: Thierry Reding <thierry.reding@gmail.com>
Signed-off-by: Thierry Reding <treding@nvidia.com>
Link: https://patchwork.freedesktop.org/patch/msgid/20180309233332.1769-1-eric@anholt.net

diff --git a/drivers/gpu/drm/panel/panel-simple.c b/drivers/gpu/drm/panel/panel-simple.c
index 5591984a392b..f9649bded63f 100644
--- a/drivers/gpu/drm/panel/panel-simple.c
+++ b/drivers/gpu/drm/panel/panel-simple.c
@@ -1597,7 +1597,7 @@ static const struct panel_desc ontat_yx700wv03 = {
 		.width = 154,
 		.height = 83,
 	},
-	.bus_format = MEDIA_BUS_FMT_RGB888_1X24,
+	.bus_format = MEDIA_BUS_FMT_RGB666_1X18,
 };
 
 static const struct drm_display_mode ortustech_com43h4m85ulc_mode  = {
-- 
2.25.1

### Modifications in Each File

**File: `drivers/gpu/drm/panel/panel-simple.c`**

- The `bus_format` value for the `ontat_yx700wv03` panel description was changed from `MEDIA_BUS_FMT_RGB888_1X24` to `MEDIA_BUS_FMT_RGB666_1X18`. This modification addresses issues related to incorrect color output observed with the panel.

### Relationships between Modifications

The patch modifies the panel description to correctly set the bus format for the Ontat panel. This change is significant in rectifying a bug (identified as a bad color output) that emerged after a previous refactoring where the device was not updated with the correct bus format. The fix is pointed out as necessary due to inconsistencies experienced during device testing, and it relates directly to addressing issues introduced in a prior commit (Fixes: e8b6f561b2ee).

drm/panel: simple: Fix the bus format for the Ontat panel

This fixes bad color output.  When I was first testing the device I

to use the bus_format information from the panel driver, I failed to
actually update the panel.

Signed-off-by: Eric Anholt <eric@anholt.net>
Fixes: e8b6f561b2ee ("drm/panel: simple: Add the 7" DPI panel from Adafruit")
Cc: Thierry Reding <thierry.reding@gmail.com>
Signed-off-by: Thierry Reding <treding@nvidia.com>
Link: https://patchwork.freedesktop.org/patch/msgid/20180309233332.1769-1-eric@anholt.net

Here is the root cause:
The bug was caused by the failure to update the bus format for the Ontat panel during a refactor that aimed to utilize bus_format information from the panel driver. This oversight led to the panel operating with an incorrect color format, resulting in bad color output.

Reason:
The bus format was incorrectly set to `MEDIA_BUS_FMT_RGB888_1X24`, which specifies a 24-bit color format. This mismatch caused the Ontat panel to operate with an incorrect color format, leading to bad color output.

The code statements that fix the bug are:

Reason:
The patch updates the bus format to `MEDIA_BUS_FMT_RGB666_1X18`, which correctly matches the panel's expected color format. This change ensures that the panel receives the appropriate color data, resolving the issue with bad color output.
